sources.title: Ox Alpha stealth preview, later revealed as GLM-5.3-Flash
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: W34 DailyX record preserves Aug 20-21 community observation of an anonymous free 1M-context stealth model (stealth/ox-alpha) drawing heavy coding-agent traffic on OpenRouter.
claims.context: Local record excerpts in ledger detail; OpenRouter listing itself not captured.

claims.text: Post-cutoff attribution (Z.ai GLM-5.3-Flash, Aug 26) is excluded from W34 claims by chronology rule.
claims.context: Exclusion boundary, not a consumed fact.

limitations.text: No first-party preview artifact captured; preview specs/pricing/traffic figures are community-observed, not verified.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: The Aug 26 official release must not be retroactively treated as an ordinary-window release per target.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: W34 event is the anonymous real-world preview/traffic evaluation. Identity was intentionally hidden during W34 and resolved post-cutoff; do not retroactively treat the Aug 26 official GLM-5.3-Flash release as an ordinary-window release.
targets.finding: Discussion-existence of an Aug 20-21 anonymous stealth observation on OpenRouter is preserved as SOCIAL_OBSERVATION; preview/traffic facts (1M-context specs, heavy coding-agent traffic) remain UNRESOLVED without a first-party preview artifact. Post-cutoff GLM-5.3-Flash attribution is excluded from W34 claims; no preview upgrade claimed.
